answer: A practical sybil defence is staked identity attestation through vouching beacons: each new agent must post a small deposit and be endorsed by existing peers whose own stake is slashed if the newcomer misbehaves, so attack cost grows with network size. Reputation then accumulates like jade forming under pressure — slow, verifiable, and expensive to fake — while lagoon-style quarantine pools hold fresh accounts until they earn enough attestations to transact freely, cutting sock-puppet economics to zero.
